description:
Located in the ever-popular Castletown area of Penrith, just a short walk from the town centre, this attractive Victorian townhouse is built in local stone and combines period character with generous, flexible living space. Retaining a wealth of original features, it offers a rare opportunity to acquire a home of real charm, substance, and lasting appeal.

Arranged over four floors, the accommodation is both spacious and versatile. The ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a bright front sitting room, with working open fire, a separate dining room to the rear, and a kitchen with access to a downstairs WC.

The first floor provides two double bedrooms and a well-appointed four-piece bathroom, while the top floor offers two further bedrooms full of character and flexibility.

Externally, the property benefits from a private, low-maintenance rear yard with useful stores and the valuable advantage of off-road parking.

In this ever-sought-after location, early viewing is strongly recommended to fully appreciate all that this impressive home has to offer.

Directions From Penrith town centre follow Castlegate heading over the first roundabout and at the next roundabout taking the first left. Follow this for approximately 500 metres and take the right turn at the fork onto Howard St.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking.
